title: Scanning an initial run of ones
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean word and $r\in\mathbb N$. Starting in phase $\mathrm{n0}$ with counter $r$ and scanning $w$ from left to right, the scan ends in phase $\mathrm{sep}$ with counter $r+L$ if $w$ contains a false bit, where $L$ is the length of its initial run of true bits; if $w$ contains no false bit, it ends in phase $\mathrm{n0}$ with counter $r+|w|$.
